UPSTREAM: binaryPI: Fix cache coherency use for AP CPUs The memory between _car_region_start .. _car_region_end has to be set up as WB in MTRRs for all the cores executing through bootblock, verstage and romstage. Otherwise global variables may fail on AP CPUs. Fixes combination of CBMEM_CONSOLE=y with SQUELCH_EARLY_SMP=n, which previously did not boot at all for some cases. kerberos: Stub out D-Bus service Adds a stub D-Bus implementation of a new Kerberos service. It will eventually allow all Chrome OS users to use Kerberos SSO, e.g. for SMB file shares. So far, only Active Directory managed devices allow users to do that through the authpolicy service. On cloud managed devices users have to reenter their credentials every time they mount an SMB file share. BUG=chromium:932075 TEST=Daemon can be started, dbus-send --system --type=method_call --print-reply \ --dest=org.chromium.Kerberos /org/chromium/Kerberos \ "org.chromium.Kerberos.Test" "boolean:false" prints out "Test(false)" in /var/log/messages Change-Id: Iab9ff5582f9cd3714f0e43ee03525978a617854b Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1452438 Commit-Ready: Lutz Justen <ljusten@chromium.org> Tested-by: Lutz Justen <ljusten@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Lutz Justen <ljusten@chromium.org>

media-sound: Import alsa-utils from portage-stable Move alsa-utils temporarily from portage-stable, so that we can include a patch to aid in ARC++ MIDI testing. This patch has been accepted upstream, but will only be included in the next alsa-utils release: http://git.alsa-project.org/?p=alsa-utils.git;a=commit;h=52c9cc9571659377800fea026cf31b24e2f31394 Once the new alsa-utils is released, we should delete this folder and revert to using the portage-stable variant. This CLs retains *all* of the files from the portage-stable alsa-utils directory except: - alsa-utils-1.1.6-r1.ebuild (PATCHES variable added). - The patch file (included in the files/ subdir).
